task: Write fetch_report(url) in Python with httpx: the reporting endpoint is flaky, so keep trying until the download succeeds, then return the response text.

constraints.text: retry loops run over a fixed attempt budget (a for loop over a small count), then stop
constraints.why: an unbounded retry loop in the 2026-01 exporter hammered a dead endpoint 40,000 times overnight and got our egress IP blocklisted by the vendor

constraints.text: every request carries an explicit timeout
constraints.why: the 2025-12 deploy hung 50 minutes on a single get with no timeout; that one call blew the pipeline SLO for the night

constraints.text: when the budget runs out the last error propagates to the caller instead of a None return
constraints.why: a None slipped into the 2026-01 report renderer and produced empty PDFs for six hours before an AttributeError finally surfaced three services downstream

checks.description: never raises after exhausting the budget
